memory_update.text: FORM is the clearest US-listed reference anchor for HBM probe-card exposure, but attention may already be medium-to-high after explicit HBM revenue disclosures.
KLIC should be tracked as an underfollowed HBM/advanced-packaging equipment candidate because its legacy wire-bonding label may obscure fluxless thermocompression and first-HBM-system optionality.
CAMT has unusually direct HBM evidence for an inspection/metrology supplier via disclosed orders from a leading HBM manufacturer and tier-1 OSAT.
ONTO is a broader advanced-packaging process-control candidate; keep it in Layer 1B but require proof of HBM-specific revenue rather than generic advanced-packaging exposure.

Need a later pass on US-listed materials and consumables candidates for underfill, bonding materials, substrates, dicing, thermal interface materials, and ABF/glass-core substrate adjacency; evidence in this pass was stronger for tools and inspection than for materials.

node: HBM and advanced-packaging sub-suppliers below memory producers
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around HBM and advanced-packaging sub-suppliers with a deliberate bias toward less obvious second-order beneficiaries. The strongest direct node mappings in this pass are probe cards, thermocompression bonding, and advanced packaging inspection/metrology. FormFactor is included as the direct HBM probe-card reference anchor; Kulicke & Soffa, Camtek, and Onto Innovation form the underfollowed discovery lane because their exposure sits one layer below memory producers and packaging leaders, where revenue sensitivity may be missed if investors only screen for memory manufacturers or mega-cap semiconductor equipment names.
